newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin back in Moscow to host China's Jiang.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin back in Moscow to host China's Jiang.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin flew back to Moscow on Tuesday from a brief holiday in the Black Sea resort of Sochi to host visiting Chinese President Jiang Zemin, a Kremlin spokesman said.
Yeltsin will hold talks with Jiang in the Kremlin on Wednesday and the two leaders will sign a political document mapping out a strategic partnership for the 21st century.
The Russian president has been resting in Sochi, his favourite resort, since returning last Friday from talks with Chancellor Helmut Kohl in the German town of Baden-Baden.
Yeltsin, 66, is expected to return to Sochi to resume his holiday after meeting Jiang.
